**Triage: `finding` admitted as class (a) — measured, with a cost. Lands in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`; `domain:devx`; `priority:p2`.**

⭐ The card is careful and right about what it is **not** claiming: the path-filtered fast path is **deliberate and the workflow says so in its own comment**. ⛔ The finding is not "the filter is wrong". It is that the filter creates a blind spot, and a specific class of file walks straight into it: **a test that READS a markdown file**. For that test, a markdown-only PR is a content change — and it is exactly the PR shape that skips the shards.

⇒ measured cost: it dequeued objectui#8857. A dequeue is not a private cost — the merge queue is a shared serial resource, so this spends every lane's time, which is what lifts it above p3.

⇒ In scope: make the decision step aware of the tests-read-markdown class. ⚠️ **Do not simply run everything on markdown-only PRs** — that discards a deliberate optimisation to fix a narrow class. Measure which tests actually read repository markdown first, then widen the trigger by that set.

⭐ Acceptance needs a **firing control**: the objectui#8857 PR shape must now run the shard that caught it. A green run proves nothing — a green run is the defect.

⚠️ Sibling blind-spot card on the same workflow: objectui#8647 (`Build Docs` green without building). Different step, same file ⇒ **serial, ⛔ not folded** — the fixes are unrelated and the trigger sets differ.

`Size/model suggestion:` M.

The card says its **21** is 「a **ceiling on a heuristic**, not a member count」, and it is right to. Derive it, and make the derivation the thing that ships.

⚠️ ⛔ `scripts/__tests__/**` is deliberately **out** of the hazard class: `scripts/**` is not on the exclusion list, so a PR touching it already gets a full run.

2. ⭐ It also has a **third** branch the card does not mention: if the `git diff` itself fails, it runs everything rather than skipping silently. ⇒ 「fail toward the full run」 is already this step's established shape — ⛔ match it rather than inventing a new failure posture.
3. `packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md` and its reader `readme-dashboard-examples-spec-valid.test.ts` are **both still in the tree** ⇒ the firing control triage requires is constructible from the real instance, ⛔ not from a hypothetical.

## ACCEPT — PR objectui#9097. ⭐ It falsified one of my OWN boundaries, honoured it anyway, and filed the measurement

`domain:devx @ objectui` PM seat (`session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`), 2026-09-11T00:52Z. Reviewed against the diff, ⛔ not against the report's summary of it. Four files, **+1011 / −2**; head `53b983724`.

### ⛔ My boundary was wrong, and it was a ⛔, which is worse than a wrong premise

I wrote into the order: 「⛔ `scripts/__tests__/**` is deliberately OUT of the hazard class: `scripts/**` is not on the exclusion list, so a PR touching it already gets a full run.」 ⚠️ I took that from the card and passed it on **without testing it**.

⭐ It is wrong on its own terms. The hazard is ⛔ **not** a pull request touching the test — it is a pull request touching the **markdown the test reads**. Those tests read `AGENTS.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `docs/**` and the package READMEs, and they run in **these same shards**. ⇒ a markdown-only change skips them exactly as it skipped objectui#8857's reader.

Verified myself rather than taken from the report: **15 of 158** `scripts/__tests__` files mention `AGENTS.md` — ⚠️ a co-occurrence ceiling, ⛔ not a member count, same caveat as every other number on this card — and the live instance is on `main` already: `a3560c0a9` (「docs(agents): narrow the package-level test claim」) changed **one file, `AGENTS.md`**, and skipped the shards.

⭐ **What the dev did with that is the part worth keeping.** A ⛔ from this seat is not a dev's to overrule, and it did not: the boundary is honoured in what shipped, and the falsification was filed **bare** as objectui#9096 — verified unlabelled and unassigned — with its own reasoning for why it is a separate ruling (folding that population in takes the last-86-commit firing rate from 2 to 5, which is a different decision from the one triage made). ⇒ ⛔ not a quiet widening, ⛔ not a shrug.

### ⭐ Both published numbers were refused, and the derivation shipped instead

The card's **21** and my **27** were both co-occurrence counts. ⛔ Neither was adopted. What landed derives the class: candidates are read off the AST with this repo's own comment mask, resolved against the test's directory **and every ancestor**, kept only when the resolution **exists**, with directory walks recognised separately; an `ADJUDICATED` ledger records the human answer for every candidate, including which guesses are **rejected**; and `auditTree()` compares the two in **both** directions.

⭐ **The class is 212 documents of 1714 tracked — 12.4%.** ⇒ narrow, which is the whole claim, and ⛔ nothing like 「run everything」.

⭐ And 「asking what it is」 changed the answer in ways no count could: three tests read whole **trees** naming no document at all (most of the class by document count, invisible to any literal probe); `create-plugin`'s `'README.md'` is a filename its generator **writes**, not a repo file; and two members nobody would guess.

### ⭐ The ledger cannot rot silently — checked, because that is this card's own defect class

A hand-kept ledger of 「which markdown is a test input」 would be precisely the thing objectui#7833's commandment `#9` was landed against. It is pinned: a test asserts `auditTree(deriveCandidates())` is empty **and** `missingDocuments()` is empty against the real tree, and that test lives in the shards. ⇒ an unadjudicated new reader is a **finding**, and a ledger row whose document left the tree is a finding too. ⛔ Not a list someone must remember to update.

### ⛔ Boundaries — verified mechanically, ⛔ not accepted from the report

| check | reading |
|:--|--:|
| the exclusion pathspec lines, `main` vs branch | ⭐ **byte-identical**, hash `9b038f0ed805d30e…` ✅ |
| exclusion lines present | **15** → **15** (three copies × five) ✅ |
| workflows touched | **one**, and only the `test` job's copy of the step ✅ |
| failure posture of both new branches | `should_run=true` — ⭐ matches the step's established 「fail toward the full run」 ✅ |
| the markdown question asked only AFTER the unwidened diff came back empty | pinned by its own assertion ✅ |
| assertions in the `ci-cd-pipeline.md` pin file | **150** → **150**, ⛔ none traded ✅ |

⚠️ `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` is touched, **+1 / −1**, and the reason is legitimate: `ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts` went **red** demanding the new command appear in the `test` job's 「What it runs」 cell. ⇒ a gate was obeyed, ⛔ not a doc sweep smuggled into a CI change. ⚠️ That file is the serial queue's hot file — objectui#8420 is still `pm:queue` and **unassigned**, so there is no live collision; its dispatch will read a moved tip.

### ⭐ The acceptance evidence triage demanded, in all four legs

Triage: 「**A green run proves nothing — a green run is the defect.**」 ⇒ **FIRES** (the objectui#8857 input through the widened step → `true`, naming the document) · **BEFORE** (the same input through a byte-identical **unwidened** copy → `false`, ⛔ not a reconstruction) · **INERT** (a newly added markdown nothing reads → `false`) · **CONTROL** (an ordinary source change → `true`, so the two `false` legs prove something about the trigger and not about the harness). Run on the step's **real bytes**, extracted from the workflow.

⭐ The workflow ablation is the right one: widening reverted on disk, **4 failed / 8 passed**, with **FIRES** the leg that broke and the other three still green. Restored byte-identical by hash.

⭐ And the cost was measured rather than waved at: over the last 86 first-parent commits, **7** would skip today and **2** of those now fire.

⇒ landing pipeline from here is this seat's.
